title: Conversion Markup Added where a Hotel Rate Plans Prepayment Was Taken in Another Currency
content:
Where the prepayment on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation was presented to the guest in a currency other than the US dollar, a conversion markup is added to the amount withheld. How much is added turns on the currency the prepayment lines were presented in and on whether the rate plan booked takes the whole stay at booking.

## The rule

1. Where the prepayment on the reservation was presented to the guest in a currency other than the US dollar and the rate plan booked takes the whole stay at booking, the rate plan's currency conversion markup is added to the amount withheld.
2. Where the prepayment was presented in a currency other than the US dollar and the rate plan booked does not take the whole stay at booking, half that markup is added — that is, 50 percent of the markup the plan carries.
3. Where the prepayment was presented in US dollars, no markup is added.

The currency looked to is the one carried by the most recent prepayment line posted on the reservation.

## The markup each plan carries, and whether it takes the whole stay at booking

| Rate plan | Whole stay taken at booking | Conversion markup, percent | Markup added where the prepayment was in another currency, percent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | yes | 3.5 | 3.5 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | yes | 3.5 | 3.5 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no | 3.0 | 1.5 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | no | 3.0 | 1.5 |
| Member Flex Rate | no | 2.5 | 1.25 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | no | 2.5 | 1.25 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 2.0 | 2.0 |

The right-hand column is the left-hand markup in full on the three plans that take the whole stay at booking, and 50 percent of it on the four that do not. Where the prepayment was presented in US dollars, no markup is added on any plan.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

An amount withheld of 400.00 USD before any markup, on a reservation whose prepayment was presented in a currency other than the US dollar:

- On the All-Inclusive Flex Rate, which takes the whole stay at booking, the markup added is 2.0 percent and the figure becomes 408.00 USD.
- On the Semi-Flexible Rate, which does not, the markup added is half of 3.0 percent, being 1.5 percent, and the figure becomes 406.00 USD.
- Had the prepayment been presented in US dollars, the figure would stand at 400.00 USD on either plan.
